frequency_question: How often does a complex industrial policy or financing scheme complete drafting, inter-ministerial consultation, cabinet/financial clearance, and final gazette notification within 302 days or less?
membership_rule: Includes all major subsidy, financial incentive, or credit guarantee schemes initiated by central economic/infrastructure ministries in India; excludes minor amendments or routine administrative circulars.

cases.name: PLI Scheme for Auto and Auto Components

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 major national industrial/automotive schemes examined; all met the sub-302-day constraint once initiated.
known_gaps: Sample limited to major flagship schemes where bureaucratic priority was explicitly high.
skeleton: Ministry policy formulation cycles involving inter-ministerial consultations and financial approvals
multiplier: 4 successful major scheme rollouts evaluated within standard administrative timelines (averaging 6 to 10 months total duration from concept to gazette notification).
validity_reason: Administrative procedures for central ministry notifications remain stable under current rules of business.
